dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Jaguars (7-3) Week 12 Briefing: Pass-Rush Review & Injury Updates Ahead of Titans
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Liam Coen and the medical staff evaluate DE Danny Striggow (concussion), C Robert Hainsey (knee), RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle), and CB Jarrian Jones (chest) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Demetrius Harvey](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4882093/bhayshul-tuten#:~:text=Tuten%20%28ankle%29%20wasn't%20spotted%20at%20Wednesday's%20practice). DE B.J. Green II (forearm) and G Patrick Mekari (back (surgery)) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation [Travis Holmes](https://www.bigcatcountry.com/jacksonville-jaguars-injuries/91895/jaguars-open-patrick-mekaris-21-day-practice-window).

Week 12 Titans Outlook: Liam Coen and DC Anthony Campanile open installation for the Tennessee Titans (1-9, JAX -14.5, HC Robert Saleh, OC Brian Daboll & DC Gus Bradley (EverBank Stadium))—a unit ranked #4 in Field Goal % (94.7%) as Jacksonville prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Michael DiRocco](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50570558/jaguars-loss-giants-trevor-lawrence-takes-blame) [Gus Logue](https://www.bigcatcountry.com/jacksonville-jaguars-odds/91696/jaguars-vs-titans-odds-week-12-opening-lines-point-spread-total).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 7-3 (1st in AFC South • #3 Seed in AFC), Jacksonville carries a 98.4% postseason projection, 94.4% AFC South division title mark, and 6.1% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Matt Warren](https://www.bigcatcountry.com/jacksonville-jaguars-nfl-playoffs/91872/afc-playoff-picture-jacksonville-jaguars-cincinnati-bengals-loss).

Around the Beat: Jacksonville Jaguar News: Brian Thomas Jr. remains a trade candidate in 2027 [Michael Peterson](https://www.bigcatcountry.com/jacksonville-jaguars-draft/91508/jacksonville-jaguar-news-brian-thomas-jr-trade-candidate-49ers).
